summary: Iterates the 2D spatial-grid cells overlapped by an axis-aligned box centred on position a3 with radius a4. Computes the four clamped cell coordinates via CRTFtol of (pos -/+ radius - origin) * inverseScale: X range from this+0x924 (origin) and this+0x928 (scale) using a3[0], Y range from this+0x92C and this+0x930 using a3[2]. Each coordinate is clamped to [0, 7] and any clamp sets an overflow flag. When the X and Y ranges are non-degenerate, calls ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate on every cell in the range passing the tag value at this+0x934. If the overflow flag was set, additionally calls ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate on the overflow list. Finally increments the counter at this+0x934 and returns the new value. Part of the session/grid subsystem invoked by ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch.

operations.description: Compute clamped X min cell index v6 = CRTFtol((a3[0] - a4 - origin(this+0x924)) * scale(this+0x928)), clamped to [0, 7]; set overflow flag when clamping occurs.
Compute clamped X max cell index v8 = CRTFtol((a4 + a3[0] - origin(this+0x924)) * scale(this+0x928)), clamped to [0, 7]; set overflow flag when clamping occurs.
Compute clamped Y min cell index v21 = CRTFtol((a3[2] - a4 - origin(this+0x92C)) * scale(this+0x930)), clamped to [0, 7]; set overflow flag when clamping occurs.
Compute clamped Y max cell index v20 = CRTFtol((a4 + a3[2] - origin(this+0x92C)) * scale(this+0x930)), clamped to [0, 7]; set overflow flag when clamping occurs.
Skip the cell iteration entirely when the X range is degenerate (v6 > v8).
For each X cell in [v6, v8] and each Y cell in [v21, v20], call ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate(cellPtr, tag at this+0x934, a2, a3, a4); cells advance by 9 dwords per step and rows by 72 bytes.
When any coordinate was clamped (overflow flag set), call ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate on the overflow list.
Increment the counter at this+0x934 and return the new value.
Invoked from the frame-path caller ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch (0x004EB430).
